name: Eureka-Bench-Logs
description:
This repository contains the logs from the Eureka ML Insights framework, as described in the Github repository.
Relevant links:

Technical report - Eureka: Evaluating and Understanding Large Foundation Models
Technical report - Inference-Time Scaling for Complex Tasks: Where We Stand and What Lies Ahead
Technical report - Phi-4-reasoning technical report
Project Website

All logs are organized by benchmark, model family, and model name.
For any questions on the logs or evaluation code, please… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/microsoft/Eureka-Bench-Logs.
evaluation_method: varied (accuracy, exact_match, pass@k, human_eval, task_success_rate depending on benchmark)
general_score_metric: varied (no single metric; accuracy / exact_match / pass@k / human_eval aggregated per-benchmark)
reputation: A Microsoft research project dataset of evaluation logs; used by researchers studying large-model evaluation and inference-time scaling but not a single standardized public benchmark.
